scope: Actual Multiplayer session, adapter and touch source in deterministic VM with synthetic capability/native packets; no native engine, Android, network or public-room actions.
checks: rendered spectator world reveals without owned facilities and preserves Music, Lobby and native status
watching another player never grants their owner menus even with inconsistent allow flag
player-to-observer transition closes stale owner overlays once and normal owner state restores controls
adapter denies all owner input and automatic Combat for spectator and watched-player identities
adapter camera capability is separate from ownership and rejects explicit unsafe camera frames
same-poll observer transition cannot accept an old owner input acknowledgement
late facility callback cannot open owner pages after its refresh becomes observer-only
observer cannot receive stale owned research reports while terrain remains usable
spectator short and held world taps forward no selection or orders
spectator delayed swipe pans with middle drag rather than box selection
spectator pinch and minimap camera remain available even without world-owner safety
watched-player and unsafe-camera packets cannot bypass facade or queued touch guards
normal owner taps, truck routing, box selection and legacy packets retain their paths
observer-only CSS fences dynamically recreated shared panels without affecting room or normal players
